```{r cars,fig.height=8,fig.width=20}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
rm(list = ls())
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)
library(ggtext)     # ← 用于渲染 HTML 富文本（粗体 + 斜体）

# ====================== Read data ======================
da_raw <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig2_data.xlsx", sheet = "A")

# Modify treatment groups: Acidified / Non-acidified -> Acid added / Control
da_raw <- da_raw %>%
  filter(treatment %in% c("Acidified", "Non-acidified")) %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment,
                            levels = c("Non-acidified", "Acidified"),
                            labels = c("Control", "Acid added")))

# ---- Colors: purple & blue ----
group_colors <- c("#B07AA1", "#6BAED6")  # purple (Control), blue (Acid added)

# ====================== General plotting function (two-sided Welch's t-test) ======================
make_boxplot <- function(data, yvar, ylab) {
  
  # ---------- Two-sided Welch's t-test (unequal variance) ----------
  cat(sprintf("\n########## %s - two-sided Welch's t-test (var.equal = FALSE) ##########\n", yvar))
  fml <- as.formula(paste(yvar, "~ treatment"))
  
  diff_test <- data %>%
    t_test(fml, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided")
  
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s test result ===\n", yvar))
  print(diff_test)
  
  # ---------- Generate HTML labels ----------
  #   - t and p: bold italic  -> <b><i>...</i></b>
  #   - =, numbers, comma: bold upright (inside <b> but outside <i>)
  #   - p < 0.001: scientific notation (1 decimal); otherwise 3 decimals
  diff_test <- diff_test %>%
    mutate(
      label = ifelse(
        p < 0.001,
        sprintf("<b><i>t</i> = %.2f, <i>p</i> = %.1e</b>", statistic, p),
        sprintf("<b><i>t</i> = %.2f, <i>p</i> = %.3f</b>", statistic, p)
      ),
      x_pos = 1.5,
      y_pos = max(data[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
    )
  
  # ---------- Plot ----------
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = treatment, y = .data[[yvar]], fill = treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = treatment),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.15),
      size = 12, alpha = 0.5,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    # HTML-rendered label: t and p bold italic; rest bold upright
    geom_richtext(
      data = diff_test,
      aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = label),
      size = 9,
      fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "pt"),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(x = "", y = ylab) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 28, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 26, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 26, face = "bold", angle = 90),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1.5)
    )
  return(p)
}

# ====================== Plot three figures separately (order: pH -> MRG -> ARG) ======================
p_pH  <- make_boxplot(da_raw, "pH",  "Soil pH")

p_MRG <- make_boxplot(da_raw, "MRG", "Relative abundance of MRGs (x/Gb)")
p_ARG <- make_boxplot(da_raw, "ARG", "Relative abundance of ARGs (x/Gb)")

# ====================== Combine three plots horizontally and save ======================
p_all <- p_pH | p_MRG | p_ARG

print(p_all)
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig2abc.pdf", plot = p_all,
       width = 20, height = 8, dpi = 600,
       device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r,fig.height=5,fig.width=8}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ===== 0. Environment =====
rm(list = ls())
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ===== 1. Read data =====
file  <- "~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig2_data.xlsx"
abund <- read_excel(file, sheet = "A_MRG_abundance")
meta  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "A_group")
anno  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "A_MRG_ID")

# ===== 2. Standardize column names =====
colnames(abund)[1] <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[1]  <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[ncol(meta)] <- "treatment2"
colnames(anno)[1] <- "gene_id"
colnames(anno)[2] <- "MRG"

# ===== 3. Wide-to-long on the abundance table =====
abund_long <- abund %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id,
               names_to  = "gene_id",
               values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
    gene_id   = sub("^X", "", as.character(gene_id)),
    gene_id   = sub("\\.\\.\\..*$", "", gene_id),
    abundance = as.numeric(abundance),
    abundance = replace_na(abundance, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_id, gene_id) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# ===== 4. Clean annotation and treatment tables =====
meta2 <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, treatment2) %>%
  mutate(sample_id  = as.character(sample_id),
         treatment2 = as.character(treatment2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

anno2 <- anno %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, MRG) %>%
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id),
         MRG     = as.character(MRG)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MRG), MRG != "") %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ===== 5. Merge =====
df <- abund_long %>%
  left_join(anno2, by = "gene_id") %>%
  left_join(meta2, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  mutate(MRG = replace_na(MRG, "Unclassified"))

df$treatment2 <- factor(df$treatment2,
                        levels = c("Non-acidified", "Acidified"))

cat("Original total abundance:", sum(abund_long$abundance), "\n")
cat("Merged total abundance:  ", sum(df$abundance), "\n")

# ===== 6. Sum abundance by MRG within each sample =====
df_sample_mrg <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment2, sample_id, MRG) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Mean of each MRG per treatment
bar_df <- df_sample_mrg %>%
  group_by(treatment2, MRG) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ===== 7. Select MRGs to keep =====
must_keep <- c("Iron", "Manganese", "Copper")

mrg_rank <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(MRG) %>%
  summarise(mrg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mrg_total))

top10    <- mrg_rank %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% pull(MRG)
keep_mrg <- union(top10, must_keep)

cat("MRGs actually kept:\n")
print(keep_mrg)
cat("Number kept: ", length(keep_mrg), "\n")

# ===== 7.1 Collapse the rest into "Others" =====
bar_df <- bar_df %>%
  mutate(MRG2 = ifelse(MRG %in% keep_mrg, MRG, "Others")) %>%
  group_by(treatment2, MRG2) %>%
  summarise(mean = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(MRG = MRG2)

# ===== 7.2 Define top-to-bottom visual order = Top10 descending mean + Others last =====
mrg_order_top_down <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(MRG) %>%
  summarise(mrg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(MRG != "Others") %>%
  arrange(desc(mrg_total)) %>%
  pull(MRG)

mrg_order_top_down <- c(mrg_order_top_down, "Others")

# Bars stack bottom-up, so levels are set directly to the top-to-bottom order
bar_df$MRG <- factor(bar_df$MRG, levels = mrg_order_top_down)

# ===== 8. Fixed colors for 21 metals + Unclassified + Others =====
col_all <- c(
  "Aluminium"    = "#4E79A7",
  "Antimony"     = "#F28E2B",
  "Arsenic"      = "#59A14F",
  "Cadmium"      = "#E15759",
  "Chromium"     = "#B07AA1",
  "Cobalt"       = "#9C755F",
  "Copper"       = "#F0A12C",
  "Gold"         = "#BAB0AC",
  "Iron"         = "#B02226",
  "Lead"         = "#FF9DA7",
  "Magnesium"    = "#A0CBE8",
  "Manganese"    = "#009E73",
  "Mercury"      = "#8CD17D",
  "Molybdenum"   = "#F1CE63",
  "Nickel"       = "#D4A6C8",
  "Selenium"     = "#D7B5A6",
  "Silver"       = "#FABFD2",
  "Tellurium"    = "#C9C9C9",
  "Tungsten"     = "#B6992D",
  "Vanadium"     = "#86BCB6",
  "Zinc"         = "#A6A6A6",
  "Unclassified" = "#E8E8E8",
  "Others"       = "#D3D3D3"
)

col_use <- col_all[mrg_order_top_down]

missing_col <- setdiff(mrg_order_top_down, names(col_use))
if (length(missing_col) > 0) {
  col_use <- c(col_use,
               setNames(rep("#D3D3D3", length(missing_col)), missing_col))
}

# ===== 9. Plot =====
# Element symbol mapping
element_symbols <- c(
  "Aluminium" = "Al",
  "Antimony"  = "Sb",
  "Arsenic"   = "As",
  "Cadmium"   = "Cd",
  "Chromium"  = "Cr",
  "Cobalt"    = "Co",
  "Copper"    = "Cu",
  "Gold"      = "Au",
  "Iron"      = "Fe",
  "Lead"      = "Pb",
  "Magnesium" = "Mg",
  "Manganese" = "Mn",
  "Mercury"   = "Hg",
  "Molybdenum"= "Mo",
  "Nickel"    = "Ni",
  "Selenium"  = "Se",
  "Silver"    = "Ag",
  "Tellurium" = "Te",
  "Tungsten"  = "W",
  "Vanadium"  = "V",
  "Zinc"      = "Zn"
)

# Legend label function: append symbol if the metal is in the map, otherwise return as-is
label_with_symbol <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x %in% names(element_symbols),
         paste0(x, " (", element_symbols[x], ")"),
         x)
}

# X-axis label mapping
trt_labs <- c(
  "Non-acidified" = "Control",
  "Acidified"     = "Acid added"
)

p1 <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = treatment2, y = mean, fill = MRG)) +
  # Narrower bars
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack",
           width = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  # Reduce x-axis side padding so treatments appear closer
  scale_x_discrete(labels = trt_labs, expand = expansion(add = 0.3)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Relative abundance of MRGs (x/Gb)", fill = "Metal(loid) class") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_use,
                    breaks = mrg_order_top_down,
                    labels = label_with_symbol) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text          = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans"),
    # Larger legend text
    legend.title  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
    # y-axis text
    axis.text.y   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    # Larger x-axis text, horizontally centered
    axis.text.x   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold",
                                 angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid    = element_blank(),
    panel.border  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                 linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid")
  )
print(p1)

# ===== 10. Save =====
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig2d.pdf", p1,
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r,fig.height=5,fig.width=8}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ===== 0. Environment =====
rm(list = ls())
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)   # for wrapping legend labels

# ===== 1. Read data =====
file  <- "~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig2_data.xlsx"
abund <- read_excel(file, sheet = "A_ARG_abundance")
meta  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "A_group")
anno  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "A_ARG_ID")

# ===== 2. Standardize column names =====
colnames(abund)[1] <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[1]  <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[ncol(meta)] <- "treatment2"
colnames(anno)[1] <- "gene_id"
colnames(anno)[4] <- "ARG"

# ===== 3. Wide-to-long on the abundance table =====
abund_long <- abund %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id,
               names_to  = "gene_id",
               values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
    gene_id   = sub("^X", "", as.character(gene_id)),
    gene_id   = sub("\\.\\.\\..*$", "", gene_id),
    abundance = as.numeric(abundance),
    abundance = replace_na(abundance, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_id, gene_id) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# ===== 4. Clean annotation and treatment tables =====
meta2 <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, treatment2) %>%
  mutate(sample_id  = as.character(sample_id),
         treatment2 = as.character(treatment2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

anno2 <- anno %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, ARG) %>%
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id),
         ARG     = as.character(ARG)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ARG), ARG != "") %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ===== 5. Merge =====
df <- abund_long %>%
  left_join(anno2, by = "gene_id") %>%
  left_join(meta2, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  mutate(ARG = replace_na(ARG, "Unclassified"))

df$treatment2 <- factor(df$treatment2,
                        levels = c("Non-acidified", "Acidified"))

cat("Original total abundance:", sum(abund_long$abundance), "\n")
cat("Merged total abundance:  ", sum(df$abundance), "\n")

# ===== 6. Sum abundance by ARG type within each sample =====
df_sample_arg <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment2, sample_id, ARG) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

bar_df <- df_sample_arg %>%
  group_by(treatment2, ARG) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ===== 6.1 Rank by total abundance to find the top 5 =====
arg_rank <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(ARG) %>%
  summarise(arg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(arg_total))

top5 <- arg_rank %>% slice_head(n = 5) %>% pull(ARG)

cat("Top 5 ARG classes by abundance:\n")
print(top5)

# ===== 6.2 Collapse the rest into "Others" =====
bar_df <- bar_df %>%
  mutate(ARG2 = ifelse(ARG %in% top5, ARG, "Others")) %>%
  group_by(treatment2, ARG2) %>%
  summarise(mean = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(ARG = ARG2)

# ===== 6.3 Define stacking order = Top5 descending + Others last =====
arg_order <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(ARG) %>%
  summarise(arg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(ARG != "Others") %>%
  arrange(desc(arg_total)) %>%
  pull(ARG)

arg_order <- c(arg_order, "Others")

bar_df$ARG <- factor(bar_df$ARG, levels = arg_order)

# ===== 7. Color definitions =====
col_use <- c(
  "Multidrug"               = "#D65190",
  "Glycopeptide"            = "#F38B2F",
  "Rifamycin"               = "#F2E851",
  "Tetracycline"            = "#088C00",
  "Fluoroquinolone"         = "#025939",
  "Beta-lactam"             = "#214EA7",
  "Aminoglycoside"          = "#7552A7",
  "Chloramphenicol"         = "#DB6C76",
  "MLS"                     = "#8B511F",
  "Phosphonic acid"         = "#A38277",
  "Elfamycin"               = "#592E13",
  "Isoniazid-like"          = "#6E86A5",
  "Nitroimidazole"          = "#03C08B",
  "Diaminopyrimidine"       = "#DCA0DD",
  "Disinfecting agents and antiseptics" = "#BF7533",
  "Others"                  = "#D3D3D3"
)

# Keep only colors for ARGs actually present to avoid missing entries
col_use <- col_use[arg_order]
missing_col <- setdiff(arg_order, names(col_use))
if (length(missing_col) > 0) {
  col_use <- c(col_use,
               setNames(rep("#D3D3D3", length(missing_col)), missing_col))
}

# ===== 8. Plot =====
trt_labs <- c(
  "Non-acidified" = "Control",
  "Acidified"     = "Acid added"
)

p1 <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = treatment2, y = mean, fill = ARG)) +
  # Bar width matches the first script: 0.5
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack",
           width = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  # Add expand so the spacing between treatments matches the first script
  scale_x_discrete(labels = trt_labs, expand = expansion(add = 0.3)) +
  # Legend title set to Drug class
  labs(x = "", y = "Relative abundance of ARGs (x/Gb)", fill = "Drug class") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = col_use,
    breaks = arg_order,
    labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 22)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text          = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans"),
    # Legend text matches the first script
    legend.title  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
    # y-axis text matches the first script
    axis.text.y   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    # x-axis text matches the first script: horizontally centered
    axis.text.x   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold",
                                 angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid    = element_blank(),
    panel.border  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                 linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid")
  )
print(p1)

# ===== 9. Save =====
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig2e.pdf", p1,
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r,,fig.height=4,fig.width=12}
rm(list = ls())
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggtext)

plot_data1 <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig2_data.xlsx", sheet = "Lime")
plot_data1[is.na(plot_data1)] <- ""

plot_data1 <- plot_data1 %>% filter(group %in% c("PH", "MRG", "ARG"))

plot_data1$Subgroup <- dplyr::recode(plot_data1$Subgroup,
                                     "Limed"   = "Lime added",
                                     "Unlimed" = "Lime unadded")

custom_colors <- c("Lime unadded" = "#D55535",
                   "Lime added"   = "#2A77AC")

plot_data <- plot_data1
plot_data$significant <- ifelse(plot_data$pval < 0.05, "Significant", "Non-significant")
plot_data$fill_color  <- ifelse(plot_data$significant == "Significant",
                                custom_colors[plot_data$Subgroup],
                                "white")
plot_data$point_shape <- ifelse(plot_data$significant == "Significant", 16, 21)

plot_data$Subgroup <- factor(plot_data$Subgroup, levels = c("Lime added", "Lime unadded"))
plot_data$group <- factor(plot_data$group, levels = c("PH", "MRG", "ARG"))
plot_data$group <- factor(plot_data$group, labels = c("Soil pH", "MRGs", "ARGs"))

annotation_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(group, Subgroup) %>%
  summarise(
    estimate = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    pval     = first(pval),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = case_when(
      pval < 0.001 ~ paste0("<b><i>p</i> = ",
                            format(pval, digits = 2, scientific = TRUE),
                            "</b>"),
      TRUE         ~ paste0("<b><i>p</i> = ",
                            signif(pval, 3),
                            "</b>")
    ),
    # Set label x position offsets based on group and treatment
    label_x = case_when(
      group == "Soil pH" & Subgroup == "Lime unadded" ~ estimate + 0.15,
      group == "MRGs"    & Subgroup == "Lime unadded" ~ estimate - 0.15,
      group == "ARGs"    & Subgroup == "Lime unadded" ~ estimate - 0.15,
      group == "ARGs"    & Subgroup == "Lime added"   ~ estimate + 0.15,
      TRUE ~ estimate
    ),
    # Match label color with treatment
    label_color = custom_colors[as.character(Subgroup)]
  )

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = estimate, y = Subgroup)) +
  facet_wrap(.~group, ncol = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = estimate + 1.96 * se,
                     xmin = estimate - 1.96 * se,
                     color = Subgroup,
                     linetype = "95% CI"),
                 size = 1.5, height = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = estimate + se,
                     xmin = estimate - se,
                     color = Subgroup,
                     linetype = "±SE"),
                 size = 2.5, height = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = fill_color, color = Subgroup, shape = significant),
             size = 7, stroke = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  # Use label_x and label_color
  geom_richtext(data = annotation_data,
                aes(x = label_x, y = Subgroup, label = p_label),
                color = annotation_data$label_color,
                hjust = 0.2, vjust = -1.2, size = 5,
                fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "pt")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors,
                     breaks = c("Lime unadded", "Lime added"),
                     name   = "Treatment") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Significance",
                     values = c("Significant" = 16, "Non-significant" = 21),
                     labels = c("Significant"     = "<i>p</i> < 0.05",
                                "Non-significant" = "<i>p</i> > 0.05")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Error bars",
                        values = c("95% CI" = "solid", "±SE" = "solid"),
                        guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
                          size  = c(1.5, 2.5),
                          alpha = c(0.4, 0.7),
                          color = "black"))) +
  # Modify y-axis tick labels with line breaks and standard parentheses
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "Lime added"   = "Lime added\n(N+L vs L)",
      "Lime unadded" = "Lime unadded\n(N vs Control)"
    )
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.5) +
  # Modify x-axis title
  labs(x = 'Effect size of nitrogen additon (log response ratio)',
       y = '',
       title = " ") +
  theme_few() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(lineheight = 1.2), # Adjust line spacing for y-axis labels
    title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text  = element_markdown(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10)
  ) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                    size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"))
```

```{r,fig.height=5,fig.width=8}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ===== 0. Environment =====
rm(list = ls())
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ===== 1. Read data =====
file  <- "~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig2_data.xlsx"
abund <- read_excel(file, sheet = "L_MRG_abundance")
meta  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "L_group")
anno  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "L_MRG_ID")

# ===== 2. Standardize column names =====
colnames(abund)[1] <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[1]  <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[ncol(meta)] <- "treatment2"
colnames(anno)[1] <- "gene_id"
colnames(anno)[2] <- "MRG"

# ===== 3. Wide-to-long on the abundance table =====
abund_long <- abund %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id,
               names_to  = "gene_id",
               values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
    gene_id   = sub("^X", "", as.character(gene_id)),
    gene_id   = sub("\\.\\.\\..*$", "", gene_id),
    abundance = as.numeric(abundance),
    abundance = replace_na(abundance, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_id, gene_id) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# ===== 4. Clean annotation and treatment tables =====
meta2 <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, treatment2) %>%
  mutate(sample_id  = as.character(sample_id),
         treatment2 = as.character(treatment2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

anno2 <- anno %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, MRG) %>%
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id),
         MRG     = as.character(MRG)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MRG), MRG != "") %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ===== 5. Merge =====
df <- abund_long %>%
  left_join(anno2, by = "gene_id") %>%
  left_join(meta2, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  mutate(MRG = replace_na(MRG, "Unclassified"))

# ---- Map directly to Control / N / L / N+L ----
df$treatment2 <- factor(df$treatment2,
                        levels = c("N0-L0", "N20-L0",
                                   "N0-L45", "N20-L45"),
                        labels = c("Control", "N", "L", "N+L"))

cat("Original total abundance:", sum(abund_long$abundance), "\n")
cat("Merged total abundance:  ", sum(df$abundance), "\n")
print(table(df$treatment2))

# ===== 6. Sum abundance by MRG within each sample =====
df_sample_mrg <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment2, sample_id, MRG) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Mean of each MRG per treatment
bar_df <- df_sample_mrg %>%
  group_by(treatment2, MRG) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ===== 7. Select MRGs to keep =====
must_keep <- c("Iron", "Manganese", "Copper")

mrg_rank <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(MRG) %>%
  summarise(mrg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mrg_total))

top10    <- mrg_rank %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% pull(MRG)
keep_mrg <- union(top10, must_keep)

cat("MRGs actually kept:\n")
print(keep_mrg)
cat("Number kept: ", length(keep_mrg), "\n")

# ===== 7.1 Collapse the rest into "Others" =====
bar_df <- bar_df %>%
  mutate(MRG2 = ifelse(MRG %in% keep_mrg, MRG, "Others")) %>%
  group_by(treatment2, MRG2) %>%
  summarise(mean = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(MRG = MRG2)

# ===== 7.2 Define top-to-bottom visual order = Top10 descending mean + Others last =====
mrg_order_top_down <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(MRG) %>%
  summarise(mrg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(MRG != "Others") %>%
  arrange(desc(mrg_total)) %>%
  pull(MRG)

mrg_order_top_down <- c(mrg_order_top_down, "Others")

# Bars stack bottom-up, so levels are set directly to the top-to-bottom order
bar_df$MRG <- factor(bar_df$MRG, levels = mrg_order_top_down)

# ===== 8. Fixed colors for 21 metals + Unclassified + Others =====
col_all <- c(
  "Aluminium"    = "#4E79A7",
  "Antimony"     = "#F28E2B",
  "Arsenic"      = "#59A14F",
  "Cadmium"      = "#E15759",
  "Chromium"     = "#B07AA1",
  "Cobalt"       = "#9C755F",
  "Copper"       = "#F0A12C",   # orange-yellow
  "Gold"         = "#BAB0AC",
  "Iron"         = "#B02226",   # dark red
  "Lead"         = "#FF9DA7",
  "Magnesium"    = "#A0CBE8",
  "Manganese"    = "#009E73",   # teal
  "Mercury"      = "#8CD17D",
  "Molybdenum"   = "#F1CE63",
  "Nickel"       = "#D4A6C8",
  "Selenium"     = "#D7B5A6",
  "Silver"       = "#FABFD2",
  "Tellurium"    = "#C9C9C9",
  "Tungsten"     = "#B6992D",
  "Vanadium"     = "#86BCB6",
  "Zinc"         = "#A6A6A6",
  "Unclassified" = "#E8E8E8",
  "Others"       = "#D3D3D3"
)

# Extract colors in top-to-bottom order (for the legend)
col_use <- col_all[mrg_order_top_down]

# Fallback: assign gray for any MRG not found in col_all
missing_col <- setdiff(mrg_order_top_down, names(col_use))
if (length(missing_col) > 0) {
  col_use <- c(col_use,
               setNames(rep("#D3D3D3", length(missing_col)), missing_col))
}

# ===== 9. Plot =====
# Element symbol mapping
element_symbols <- c(
  "Aluminium" = "Al",
  "Antimony"  = "Sb",
  "Arsenic"   = "As",
  "Cadmium"   = "Cd",
  "Chromium"  = "Cr",
  "Cobalt"    = "Co",
  "Copper"    = "Cu",
  "Gold"      = "Au",
  "Iron"      = "Fe",
  "Lead"      = "Pb",
  "Magnesium" = "Mg",
  "Manganese" = "Mn",
  "Mercury"   = "Hg",
  "Molybdenum"= "Mo",
  "Nickel"    = "Ni",
  "Selenium"  = "Se",
  "Silver"    = "Ag",
  "Tellurium" = "Te",
  "Tungsten"  = "W",
  "Vanadium"  = "V",
  "Zinc"      = "Zn"
)

# Legend label function: append symbol if the metal is in the map, otherwise return as-is
label_with_symbol <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x %in% names(element_symbols),
         paste0(x, " (", element_symbols[x], ")"),
         x)
}

p1 <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = treatment2, y = mean, fill = MRG)) +
  # Narrower bars
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack",
           width = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  # Reduce x-axis side padding so treatments appear closer
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.3)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Relative abundance of MRGs (x/Gb)", fill = "Metal(loid) class") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_use,
                    breaks = mrg_order_top_down,
                    labels = label_with_symbol) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text          = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans"),
    legend.title  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    # ---- x-axis text unrotated, horizontally centered under bars ----
    axis.text.x   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold",
                                 angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid    = element_blank(),
    panel.border  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                 linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid")
  )
print(p1)

# ===== 10. Save =====
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig2i.pdf", p1,
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r,fig.height=5,fig.width=8}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ===== 0. Environment =====
rm(list = ls())
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)   # for wrapping legend labels

# ===== 1. Read data =====
file  <- "~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig2_data.xlsx"
abund <- read_excel(file, sheet = "L_ARG_abundance")
meta  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "L_group")
anno  <- read_excel(file, sheet = "L_ARG_ID")

# ===== 2. Standardize column names =====
colnames(abund)[1] <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[1]  <- "sample_id"
colnames(meta)[ncol(meta)] <- "treatment2"
colnames(anno)[1] <- "gene_id"
colnames(anno)[4] <- "ARG"

# ===== 3. Wide-to-long on the abundance table =====
abund_long <- abund %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id,
               names_to  = "gene_id",
               values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
    gene_id   = sub("^X", "", as.character(gene_id)),
    gene_id   = sub("\\.\\.\\..*$", "", gene_id),
    abundance = as.numeric(abundance),
    abundance = replace_na(abundance, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_id, gene_id) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# ===== 4. Clean annotation and treatment tables =====
meta2 <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, treatment2) %>%
  mutate(sample_id  = as.character(sample_id),
         treatment2 = as.character(treatment2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

anno2 <- anno %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, ARG) %>%
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id),
         ARG     = as.character(ARG)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ARG), ARG != "") %>%
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ===== 5. Merge =====
df <- abund_long %>%
  left_join(anno2, by = "gene_id") %>%
  left_join(meta2, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment2)) %>%
  mutate(ARG = replace_na(ARG, "Unclassified"))

# ---- Map x-axis labels to Control / N / L / N+L ----
df$treatment2 <- factor(df$treatment2,
                        levels = c("N0-L0", "N20-L0",
                                   "N0-L45", "N20-L45"),
                        labels = c("Control", "N", "L", "N+L"))

cat("Original total abundance:", sum(abund_long$abundance), "\n")
cat("Merged total abundance:  ", sum(df$abundance), "\n")
print(table(df$treatment2))

# ===== 6. Sum abundance by ARG type within each sample =====
df_sample_arg <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment2, sample_id, ARG) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Mean of each ARG per treatment
bar_df <- df_sample_arg %>%
  group_by(treatment2, ARG) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ===== 6.1 Keep only the top 5 ARGs by abundance; collapse the rest into "Others" =====
arg_rank <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(ARG) %>%
  summarise(arg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(arg_total))

top5_arg <- arg_rank %>% slice_head(n = 5) %>% pull(ARG)

bar_df <- bar_df %>%
  mutate(ARG2 = ifelse(ARG %in% top5_arg, ARG, "Others")) %>%
  group_by(treatment2, ARG2) %>%
  summarise(mean = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(ARG = ARG2)

# ===== 6.2 Define stacking order: Top5 descending mean + Others last =====
arg_order_top_down <- bar_df %>%
  group_by(ARG) %>%
  summarise(arg_total = sum(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(ARG != "Others") %>%
  arrange(desc(arg_total)) %>%
  pull(ARG)

arg_order_top_down <- c(arg_order_top_down, "Others")

bar_df$ARG <- factor(bar_df$ARG, levels = arg_order_top_down)

# ===== 7. Color definitions =====
col16 <- c(
  "Multidrug"               = "#D65190",
  "Glycopeptide"            = "#F38B2F",
  "Rifamycin"               = "#F2E851",
  "Tetracycline"            = "#088C00",
  "Fluoroquinolone"         = "#025939",
  "Beta-lactam"             = "#214EA7",
  "Aminoglycoside"          = "#7552A7",
  "Chloramphenicol"         = "#DB6C76",
  "MLS"                     = "#8B511F",
  "Phosphonic acid"         = "#A38277",
  "Elfamycin"               = "#592E13",
  "Isoniazid-like"          = "#6E86A5",
  "Nitroimidazole"          = "#03C08B",
  "Diaminopyrimidine"       = "#DCA0DD",
  "Disinfecting agents and antiseptics" = "#BF7533",
  "Unclassified"            = "#D3D3D3"
)

# Extract colors in stacking order: Top5 from col16, Others uses gray
col_use <- c()
for (arg in arg_order_top_down) {
  if (arg == "Others") {
    col_use[arg] <- "#D3D3D3"
  } else if (arg %in% names(col16)) {
    col_use[arg] <- col16[arg]
  } else {
    col_use[arg] <- "#D3D3D3"  # fallback
  }
}

# ===== 8. Plot =====
p1 <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = treatment2, y = mean, fill = ARG)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack",
           width = 0.5, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.3)) +
  # ---- Legend title set to Drug class ----
labs(x = "", y = "Relative abundance of ARGs (x/Gb)", fill = "Drug class") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = col_use,
    breaks = arg_order_top_down,
    labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 22)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text          = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans"),
    # ---- Font sizes consistent with the second script ----
    legend.title  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold",
                                 angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid    = element_blank(),
    panel.border  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                 linewidth = 1, linetype = "solid")
  )
print(p1)

# ===== 9. Save =====
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig2j.pdf", p1,
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```
